applicant_utility.summary: Getting into GIST is the scholarship: every student's tuition of 3,607,000 won per semester is fully supported, and international students additionally draw a monthly package - 140,000 won (master's) or 295,000 won (PhD) student allowance, about 100,000 won meal allowance, and a 120,000 won international student allowance if your previous-semester GPA is at least 3.0/4.5 - plus 60% of national health insurance, an annual check-up and a one-way flight reimbursement. There is nothing to apply for separately, but the allowances are performance-gated: fall below 9 credits or the GPA threshold in a semester and the monthly money stops. The Spring 2027 window closed on 7 October 2026, so the realistic next shot is the Fall window, 9 March - 8 April 2027.
applicant_utility.best_fit: STEM master's and PhD applicants who want a fully tuition-covered Korean graduate package with no separate scholarship competition, and who can keep 9+ credits and a 3.0/4.5 GPA.
application_readiness_checklist: Target the Fall window: online application and all materials in by 8 April 2027, 17:00 KST (the Spring window closed 7 October 2026)
Assemble transcripts, degree certificate and English proficiency evidence per the GIST admission guide in good time - materials must arrive, not be sent, before the deadline
Plan for the 680,000 won one-time matriculation fee unless exempt
From semester one, protect your credit load (9+) and GPA (3.0/4.5) so the international student allowance continues
common_rejection_risks: Missing the hard admission deadline - GIST requires the online application and all materials before the cut-off
Losing the monthly allowances through fewer than 9 credits, a leave of absence or overseas dispatch, disciplinary probation, or GPA below 3.0/4.5
Budgeting on 2022 research-assistantship averages, which can shift with project funding
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The remaining 40% of National Health Insurance, the 680,000 won matriculation fee (unless exempt), dormitory deposits and utilities (charged separately), and any spending beyond the monthly allowances; joining a research project typically adds substantial assistantship income.
document_audit: All admission materials must reach GIST before the deadline - late post is not cured by an early postmark
Keep transcripts and degree certificates ready for direct admission verification
alerts: GIST warns its admission dates are subject to change without prior notice - re-check the official schedule before the March-April window
Allowances expire after 4 enrolled semesters (master's allowance) or 8 semesters (doctoral benefit) - later semesters need other funding
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Single admission application through GIST's online system; financial support is registered automatically once you are admitted.

applicant_utility.summary: DGIST's Government Scholarship is registration-by-admission: no scholarship form exists, so your only task is winning a place in one of the ten listed departments - physics and chemistry, EECS, robotics and mechatronics, energy science, brain sciences, new biology, the two AI tracks, biomedical science and engineering, or quantum information science. The package is full tuition plus a minimum annual stipend of 9.6 million KRW (master's) or 14.04 million KRW (PhD), with performance-based incentives on top, and subsidised Biseul Village housing from 170,000 KRW per month. Intake rounds run several times a year - the 2027 Spring second round closed 10 September 2026 and the next round was not yet posted at verification, so watch the notice board rather than assuming a fixed calendar.
